key_idea: Just build the Champernowne words 1, 12, 123, ... as strings and compare; only a dozen are below 1e9.
sketch: Read n as a string, concatenate k=1,2,... and compare after each step, printing k on equality and -1 otherwise. O(1). Pitfall: after 123456789 the next word is 12345678910 which already exceeds 1e9, so 1000000000 is not a word.
